reason: On the tested free FRED reprint, credit z-scores begin at observation 2024-10-17 (543 observations through 2026-11-05). The full 756-observation window begins at 2026-09-14 (39 observations). A previous-day vintage makes the earliest possible decision 2024-10-18 and the latest 2026-11-06. No vintage was fetched for each of those dates. Completed replay dates: 0. No portfolio return was calculated.
blocking: A full-strategy replay needs a previous-day vintage of WALCL, WTREGEN, RRPONTSYD, the policy rate, DGS2, and BAMLH0A0HYM2 on every decision date in that credit-valid span. Credit stays fail-closed. This run has single-date snapshots, not that panel.

hypotheses.because: The comparison was written into the protocol in this folder before this run. There is no external timestamped registration. The 2021–2026 price paths were already examined. The comparison was not run.
The macro-gate ablation was not run. It is not an out-of-sample registration.

preExposure: Pull request 11 already published Yahoo price paths for SPY, GLD, GOLD.AX, and BTC-USD from 2021-11-06 through 2026-11-06. A later lookback over that period is not unseen. This study does not repeat those paths as a strategy result.
survivorship: A frozen-rule lookback can use today’s fixed universe. It does not need a historical membership tape or a theme-history tape. That hypothetical would still be a survivor set, and the price period above is pre-exposed. This run did not execute it.

credit.pageNote: On 2026-11-07 the series page listed Date Range 2023-11-07 to 2026-11-05 and said: Starting in April 2026, this series will only include 3 years of observations. For more data, go to the source.
credit.constraint: Observations before 2023-11-07 are unavailable from this tested free FRED source. That is not proof a longer free history is absent everywhere else.
credit.rule: Credit is the daily OAS series. Its z-score window is 756 observations and its minimum is 252. The z-score is null before 252 observations. The 156-week window belongs to liquidity and positioning, not to credit.
credit.failClosed: The composite is withheld until liquidity, policy, and credit each have a z-score. New risk stays off. This study does not drop credit or renormalise the remaining legs and then call the result the full strategy.
credit.vintageCutoff: A public graph vintage is a calendar date and has no intraday time. A decision on date T may use the previous calendar day’s vintage. That is a conservative availability cutoff, not an exact release timestamp.
credit.alfredApi: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/fred/series_observations.html accepts vintage_dates as a comma-separated list. No FRED API key was supplied, so that batched call was not made. Single-date public graphs did return.

cftc.publication: The CFTC page says the COT report is generally published each Friday at 3:30 p.m. Eastern Time using the immediately preceding Tuesday, and that holidays can change the release. A report file is not an ALFRED vintage. This run did not retrieve the zip and did not observe a revision history.

paperLog.captures: After 002 is applied, a refresh can store rule version, checklist version, theme-config version, the snapshot timestamp, the session date, target weights, and the close, FX, and AUD reference for each line.
paperLog.limits: The unique key keeps the first row for a rule version and session date and drops a later refresh the same day. A row is a target-weight record. It is not a filled order and it is not a historical backtest. The NAV code is tested with synthetic prices and has no production rows.
paperLog.activation: Apply db/regime/002_paper_decisions.sql yourself after review. The app does not apply it and this change does not. Until the table exists, refresh still saves the snapshot and skips the log.
